title: Tuza’s triangle packing–covering conjecture
statement: Tuza’s triangle packing–covering conjecture · 1981, sometimes dated by its 1984 publication. Every graph’s minimum triangle edge cover is at most twice its maximum edge-disjoint triangle packing.

u+1\) exists, and a DRAT proof that no triangle edge cover of size \(2
u\) exists.
